Appearance:
MR DK MODI, ADVOCATE for the Applicant(s) No. 1 - 2 NOTICE SERVED for the Respondent(s) No. 2 - 3 MS HB PUNANI, APP. for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ================================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE R.M.CHHAYA  Date : 26/08/2014  ORAL ORDER Heard Mr. D.K. Modi, learned Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. Modi pointed out that the Appellate Authority as provided under Section 70 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is yet to be constituted and the petitioners are rendered remediless.
Ms. H.B.Punani, learned APP. waives notice of rule on behalf of respondent-State.
Ad-interim relief in terms of paragraph 9(c).
Liberty to apply for final hearing after the pleadings are over.

Sd/-
